acceptance_gate_results.principle: Capture completeness is separate from method value.
Treatment must improve the paired current-feedback case study.
A learned candidate must beat predicting no state change.
A valid engine without an executed plan has no policy value.
Prediction gains cannot hide a policy-level regression.

field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Keep expected, observed, pass, and principle for every criterion.
field_principles.arc_capture_complete_score: One accounts for all four episodes; it is not an efficacy score.
field_principles.arc_method_value_score: One requires prediction lift, policy use, and no matched-game regression.
field_principles.claim_scope: Two public games permit a case study only, not a population interval.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic time and retain disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.ended_at_utc: Record the actual UTC end of terminal construction.

field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumers read ordinary top-level values.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked work, name each upstream check and exact observed and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use terminal complete_ or blocked_ prefixes and state the measured finding.
field_principles.inference_mode: Use live_gpu only when the task-owned runtime has CUDA evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal that describes the computation that ran.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare actual compute; never pad time to satisfy a class floor.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generations from usable answers.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive model use from actual calls; parse failure does not erase an invocation.
field_principles.new_solve_claimed: Require registry precheck and reproduction before any new level credit.
field_principles.per_game_results: Keep every game, seed, arm outcome, and cost for paired recomputation.
field_principles.phase_spans: Keep measured load, generation, scoring, and validation spans separate.
field_principles.policy_consumption_rows: Join engine and plan hashes to actual executed policy actions.
field_principles.population_confidence_interval: Remain null because two games cannot support a population CI.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Retain observed input hashes, resource ownership, and failures before model work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before outcomes are visible.
field_principles.raw_request_manifest: Persist every dispatched request and reply with tokens and timestamps.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: Count only newly reproduced levels from this live attempt.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, input manifests, configuration, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Retain each game-arm unit, metric, error, abstention, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC bounds so the dated evidence is auditable.
field_principles.runtime_receipt: Bind GPU, native process, offload, decoding, and lease evidence to this run.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, censored units and the fixed stop rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.selection_receipt: Prove registry precheck preceded metadata-only roster freezing.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Use live_agent_self_discovery; registered public solves receive no new credit.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact inputs and preserve quarantine and retirement state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start of this invocation.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked only for terminal work; checkpoints hold unfinished work.
field_principles.submission_configuration_diff: Keep local and submitted runtime differences explicit.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record commands, exits, and log hashes without suppressing failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the fixed verdict vocabulary; oracle authority forbids a positive verdict.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.
